title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. INCLINE PUSH-UPS ON THE 5TH STAIR, 3RD-STEP STAIR PLANK, DEAD BUG, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, CAT-COW, WALL CHEST OPENER. PUSH, BRACE, BALANCE, THEN OPEN THE FRONT BACK UP.

script.welcome: TUESDAY, GRIMES. PUSH AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. YESTERDAY THE SCALE SULKED. TODAY WE DON'T. CHEST, BELLY, BALANCE, THEN A STRETCH YOU'LL PRETEND YOU DIDN'T ENJOY. OUT OF THAT CHAIR. NOW.
script.rest: REST. NO, YOU MAY NOT CHECK YOUR EMAIL. THE EMAIL CAN WAIT. I CANNOT.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT YOUR BEST ONE. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. CHEST PUSHED, CORE BRACED, BALANCE TESTED, SPINE AND SHOULDERS OPENED. PROTEIN AT LUNCH, GRIMES, AND GO EASY ON THE EXTRAS. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, A LITTLE WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. WALK THE FEET BACK UNTIL THE BODY IS ONE STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS. SQUEEZE GLUTES AND BELLY. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS AWAY. STEADY REPS FOR 30 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE SETS OF THIRTY SECONDS. BODY LIKE A PLANK OF WOOD, NOT A HAMMOCK. CHEST DOWN TO THE STEP, PRESS IT AWAY. STAYING ON THE FIFTH TILL YOU TELL ME IT'S EASY, AND I'LL KNOW IF YOU'RE FIBBING.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STEP)
exercises.cue: FOREARMS ON THE 3RD STEP, ELBOWS UNDER SHOULDERS. WALK FEET BACK TO A STRAIGHT LINE. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE GLUTES, PULL THE BELLY BUTTON IN. NO SAGGING HIPS, NO PIKED BUTT. BREATHE STEADY. HOLD 12.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANK. THIRD STEP. THREE HOLDS OF TWELVE SECONDS. FOREARMS DOWN, BODY STRAIGHT, BUM TUCKED, BELLY TIGHT. TWELVE SECONDS, GRIMES. YOUR KETTLE TAKES LONGER THAN THAT.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STAND UP, ROLL THE SHOULDERS.
exercises.speakDone: PLANK DONE. CORE LIKE A BRICK WALL. NEARLY.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, ARMS STRAIGHT UP, KNEES BENT 90 DEGREES OVER HIPS. PRESS THE LOW BACK INTO THE FLOOR. SLOWLY LOWER OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG TOWARD THE FLOOR, EXHALE, RETURN. SWITCH. LOW BACK NEVER LIFTS.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. FLAT ON YOUR BACK, LOW BACK GLUED TO THE FLOOR. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH AWAY, SLOW, BREATHE OUT. IF THE BACK ARCHES, SHORTEN THE REACH. YOU LOOK RIDICULOUS. THAT'S HOW YOU KNOW IT'S WORKING.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUG DONE. DEEP CORE SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG BALANCE
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. BRACE THE BELLY. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LONG AND LEVEL. HOLD 3 SECONDS, HIPS SQUARE, NO TIPPING. RETURN SLOW, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH SIDE. ARM FORWARD, OPPOSITE LEG BACK, HOLD FOR THREE. HIPS LEVEL LIKE A TRAY OF TEA. SPILL IT AND I'LL HEAR ABOUT IT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.
exercises.speakDone: BIRD DOG DONE. STEADY AS A ROCK. GOOD.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: STAY ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. YOU'RE ALREADY ON ALL FOURS, SO NO EXCUSES. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. SLOW. ENJOY IT QUIETLY.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO A WALL. FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THE NEAR FOOT FORWARD AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. NO PAIN. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. YOU JUST PUSHED, NOW YOU OPEN. THAT HUNCH FROM THE KEYBOARD GOES IN THE BIN.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS TUESDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
